reconcile.note: Keil and Delitzsch resolve the count by reckoning Adam as the first link in Seth's line, making Enoch the seventh generation just as Jude states.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Steve Wells's Skeptics Annotated Bible flags the sixth-versus-seventh count as a contradiction, even while noting Jude is quoting 1 Enoch rather than the Genesis genealogy.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: Steve Wells (2013), The Skeptic's Annotated Bible (2013).

sides.snippet: Adam lived one hundred thirty years, and became the father of a son in his own likeness, after his image, and named him Seth.
sides.verseText: Adam lived one hundred thirty years, and became the father of a son in his own likeness, after his image, and named him Seth.
